use_lvmetad.description: Enable the LVM metadata cache daemon. Required for improved performance and concurrency in large LVM setups. Note: Modern LVM versions (≥2.02.170) ignore this and rely on automatic detection, but explicitly setting it ensures consistent behavior.

pidfile.description: Path to the PID file for lvmetad process.

socket.description: Unix domain socket path used by LVM tools (e.g., `pvscan`, `vgscan`) to communicate with lvmetad.

max_pending_connections.description: Maximum number of pending connections accepted by lvmetad's socket before rejecting new clients.

max_cache_size_kb.description: Maximum size (in KB) of the in-memory metadata cache. Larger values improve performance for systems with many VGs/LVs but consume more RAM.

cache_metadata.description: If true, lvmetad caches VG and LV metadata. Enable unless storage devices change very frequently (e.g., dynamic SAN reconfiguration without LVM notifications).

cache_devices.description: If true, lvmetad caches device state (e.g., presence, size, partitions). Enables faster `vgscan`/`pvscan` operations and is safe in most environments.

polling_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between scans of devices for changes when `cache_devices=true`. Set to 0 to disable polling (e.g., if using udev to notify LVM on device changes).

validate_metadata.description: If true, lvmetad validates cached metadata against on-disk contents before use (for consistency). Disable only for debugging or very high-frequency metadata updates.

log_verbose.description: If true, enables verbose logging (more detailed messages). Typically set only during troubleshooting.

log_overwrite.description: If true and logging to a file, overwrite the log file on startup (instead of appending).

log_level.description: Log verbosity level: 0=none, 1=error, 2=important, 3=info, 4=debug. Level 3 (info) is recommended for production.

log_file.description: Path to log file (empty string = use syslog instead).

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility to use when `log_file` is empty (e.g., 'local0', 'daemon').

activation_min_initial_size_percent.description: Minimum free space (% of VG) required for auto-activation of LVs. lvmetad itself does not enforce this, but it respects the value in `lvm.conf`.

items.description: Regex pattern or VG/LV name to include in auto-activation. LVs matching any pattern will be automatically activated on device arrival. Use empty list to disable auto-activation.

auto_activation_volume_list.description: List of patterns (regex or exact names) for volumes that should be auto-activated. Use `"*"` for all, or specific names/regexes to restrict.

monitoring.description: Enable DMEVENTD monitoring for thin and snapshot devices. lvmetad does not manage DMEVENTD itself, but this setting affects whether LVM tools expect monitoring to be active.

nice.description: Process priority (nice value) for lvmetad when started. More negative = higher priority. Common values: -18 (high priority), 0 (default).
